rows.traditional: 令到 A 可以 V
rows.jyutping: ling6 dou3 A ho2 ji5 V
rows.note: This is the all-purpose construction for saying that a person, thing, or circumstance makes an action possible or gives someone the ability to do it.

example.english: This new feature can enable us to hand in our homework faster.
example.traditional: 呢個新功能令到我哋可以快啲交功課。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 gung1 nang4 ling6 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 faai3 di1 gaau1 gung1 fo3

rows.note: Use this when enabling means tolerating or encouraging someone’s harmful or bad behaviour rather than simply making something possible.

example.english: They enable their son to keep bullying people.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung3 jung4 go3 zai2 seng4 jat6 haa1 jan4

rows.note: Use this for turning on a device function, feature, or setting, rather than for giving a person the ability to act.

example.english: I enable the location feature on my phone.
example.traditional: 我部手機開咗定位功能。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1 hoi1 zo2 ding6 wai6 gung1 nang4
